in_sanskrit.name: सीतकन्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has Seetha, the wife of Rama

in_marathi.name: Sitakanta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sitakanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sitakanta is derived from two Sanskrit words, 'Sita' which means 'furrowed forehead' and 'Kanta' which means 'Lord'. This name is often used to refer to Lord Rama, who was known for his wisdom and learning. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama is considered to be an embodiment of truth, righteousness, and justice.
